verdict.rationale: Stripe ships exactly this: Shared Payment Tokens grant sellers scoped access with explicit usage_limits (currency, max_amount, expires_at), merchant/seller scoping, and revocation, and Link CLI issues one-time-use virtual cards/LPTs/SPTs to agents rather than raw PANs, with human approval gates on spend. This is corroborated by docs, GitHub source, and live npm/runtime probes. missing for 10: independent hands-on third-party audit of the credential-scoping mechanics (only vendor docs + probes, no external security review), and broader geographic/GA availability (features are private preview / US-Canada-EU only).
